title: Strict tensor quotient augmentation of the intrinsic Koszul tower
statement: For X, Λ, d and generators f of d.ideal as in [def-weil-pbc-complete-coefficient-datum], let M be each fixed AdicKFlatModel. There exist chain maps v_n from the total tensor of M with the constant sheafified Koszul complex on f_j^(n+1) [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-koszul-completion] to the restriction of the changed-ring quotient complex [def-weil-pbc-completion-map]. Their composites with the Koszul degree-zero units equal the quotient augmentations, all tensor summands of nonzero Koszul degree map to zero, and the maps commute strictly with the successive power transitions. This assertion concerns the levelwise maps only, without any inverse limit or isomorphism conclusion.

proof.text: Take the specified coefficient augmentations and exterior transitions from lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-koszul-augmentation-pro-zero after lifting Λ. Identify the quotient of the lifted ring by the span-power with ULift(Λ/I^(n+1)) through the canonical quotient equivalence. The given degree-zero augmentation is the exterior degree-zero equivalence followed by the quotient, and the remaining target degrees are zero. The specified exterior transitions are the identity in degree zero and the quotient transitions commute with these augmentations.

Reindex to cohomological degree, apply constant module presheaves and module sheafification, and tensor with M. On the (p,0) summand use the balanced map m tensor b ↦ b tensor m into the restriction of the changed-ring quotient; other summands map to zero. Module sheafification transports the local balanced map to sheaves. The total tensor coproduct universal property gives v in each degree, and the tensor differential verifies it is a chain map.

The (p,0) restriction composed with the right-unitor inverse and the sheafified Koszul unit sends m to 1 tensor m. The unique local formula defining the quotient augmentation identifies this composite. For transition compatibility use the identity on degree zero and the quotient transition formula; all other summands vanish.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulQuotientTensorAugmentation (X : Scheme.{t}) (Λ : Type t) [CommRing Λ]
    (d : CompleteCoefficientDatum Λ) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → Λ)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = d.ideal) :
    ∃ (v : ∀ (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X Λ) (M : AdicKFlatModel X Λ K) (n : ℕ),
        @Quiver.Hom (CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} (adicModuleRing X Λ)) ℤ) inferInstance
          (koszulTensor X Λ r f M.complex n) (adicReductionComplex X d M n)),
      (∀ (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X Λ)
        (M : AdicKFlatModel X Λ K) (n : ℕ), koszulTensorUnit X Λ r f M.complex n ≫ v K M n =
        adicReductionAugmentation X d M n) ∧
      (∀ (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X Λ)
        (M : AdicKFlatModel X Λ K) (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (hq : q ≠ 0),
        HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor M.complex (koszulPowerSheaf X Λ r f n)
          (@curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (adicConstantRing X Λ)))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p q (p + q) rfl ≫ (v K M n).f (p + q) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X Λ)
        (M : AdicKFlatModel X Λ K) (n : ℕ), v K M (n + 1) ≫ adicReductionComplexStep X d M n =
        koszulTensorTransition X Λ r f M.complex n ≫ v K M n)
